name: Museum and Art Gallery of the Northern Territory
wiki: Museum and Art Gallery of the Northern Territory
coordinates_source: photon tourism=museum "Museum and Art Gallery of the Northern Territory"; agrees with wiki
bio: Territory museum on Bullocky Point with Aboriginal art, Cyclone Tracy and maritime galleries, and the crocodile Sweetheart.
source_note: Territory museum and art gallery on Bullocky Point with Aboriginal art, Cyclone Tracy and maritime galleries and the 18 ft crocodile Sweetheart; free admission per Wikivoyage.

name: Crocosaurus Cove
coordinates_source: osm tourism=attraction "Crocosaurus Cove"; agrees with wiki, commons
bio: City-centre crocodile attraction where you can be lowered into a tank with saltwater crocodiles in a clear cage.
source_note: Crocodile attraction in the city centre with a crocodile cage immersion experience and crocodile displays; Wikivoyage describes it as crocodiles in the middle of the city.

name: Darwin Waterfront
coordinates_source: photon highway=bus_stop "Waterfront Parklands & Recreation"; agrees with commons
bio: Harbourside precinct on the old wharf with a wave lagoon, recreation lagoon, restaurants and the Esplanade.
source_note: Harbourside precinct (Darwin Wharf Precinct on Wikivoyage, site of the 1942 bombing) with a wave lagoon and recreation lagoon, restaurants and the Esplanade; Wikivoyage and Tourism NT both name it.

name: Mindil Beach
coordinates_source: photon natural=beach "Mindil Beach"; agrees with wiki
bio: Darwin's western beach beside the casino and the sunset market, with sunset views over the Timor Sea.
source_note: Beach on Darwin's west coast beside the Mindil Beach Casino and sunset market, the site of the Territory Day fireworks; a beach stop, Wikivoyage names it under the sunset market.

name: Territory Wildlife Park
coordinates_source: osm leisure=park "Territory Wildlife Park - Main Station"; agrees with wiki
bio: Wildlife park at Berry Springs with monsoon forest, a wetlands walk, an aquarium tunnel and twice-daily bird of prey shows.
source_note: Wildlife park at Berry Springs with monsoon and paperbark forest, a wetlands walk, an aquarium tunnel beneath a saltwater crocodile and twice-daily bird of prey shows.

name: George Brown Darwin Botanic Gardens
coordinates_source: photon leisure=park "George Brown Darwin Botanic Gardens"; agrees with wiki
bio: Forty-two hectares of tropical gardens with monsoon forest, coastal foredune and woodland walks, open daily.
source_note: Tropical botanic gardens of 42 hectares with monsoon forest, coastal foredune and woodland walks; free entry, open 7AM-7PM per Wikivoyage.

name: Fannie Bay Gaol
coordinates_source: photon tourism=museum "Fannie Bay Gaol"; agrees with wiki, commons
bio: Darwin's former prison, in use from 1883 to the 1950s, with walk-through cells and the gallows.
source_note: Historic museum: former Darwin prison (1883 to 1950s) walkable inside, with the gallows; free entry, Wikivoyage gives 10:30AM-4PM.

name: East Point Reserve
coordinates_source: photon place=locality "East Point Reserve"; agrees with photon
bio: Coastal reserve north of the city with walking and cycling trails, Lake Alexander and wallabies at dawn and dusk.
source_note: Coastal reserve just north of the city with walking and cycling trails, Lake Alexander and the Darwin Military Museum; Wikivoyage suggests dawn or dusk for agile wallabies.

name: Darwin Military Museum
coordinates_source: photon tourism=museum "Darwin Military Museum"; agrees with wiki
bio: World War II museum at East Point telling the story of the 1942 bombing of Darwin and the defence of the north.
source_note: WWII military museum at East Point (Wikivoyage calls it the East Point Military Museum, Tourism NT the Darwin Military Museum: treat as one venue, see East Point Reserve).

name: Darwin Aviation Museum
coordinates_source: Wikipedia article coordinates of the museum building (Winnellie); the OSM "Aviation Museum" bus stop is 130 m away
bio: Aviation museum about 8 km from the city, home to a B-52 bomber on loan from the US Air Force.
source_note: Aviation museum about 8 km from the city with a B-52 bomber on loan from the US Air Force; Wikivoyage calls it the Aviation Heritage Centre, Tourism NT the Darwin Aviation Museum.

name: Oil Storage Tunnels
coordinates_source: Wikivoyage listing point (tunnel entrance, Kitchener Drive); a Commons photo geotag is 70 m away
bio: World War II tunnels bored into the cliff on Kitchener Drive to store oil, with historic photos inside.
source_note: WWII heritage site: long tunnels bored into the cliff on Kitchener Drive to store oil, with historic photos inside; paid entry per Wikivoyage.

name: Aquascene
bio: Doctors Gully fish-feeding sanctuary where visitors hand-feed large fish from the harbour at high tide.
source_note: Fish-feeding sanctuary at Doctors Gully beside the harbour where visitors feed large fish by hand, tide dependent, with a fee per Wikivoyage.

name: Berry Springs Nature Park
bio: Nature park with clear spring-fed swimming pools, picnic and barbecue areas and monsoon forest walks.
source_note: Nature park about 45-50 km south of Darwin with clear spring-fed swimming pools, picnic and barbecue areas and monsoon forest walks; Wikivoyage and Tourism NT name it.

name: Crocodylus Park
coordinates_source: photon tourism=zoo "Crocodylus Park"; agrees with wiki, photon, commons
bio: Crocodile park and zoo near Darwin Airport with over a thousand crocodiles plus birds, primates and big cats.
source_note: Crocodile park and zoo near Darwin Airport with more than a thousand crocodiles plus birds, primates and big cats; the Darwin Crocodile Farm, a near-duplicate name.

name: Casuarina Coastal Reserve
coordinates_source: OSM tourism=picnic_site "Dripstone Beach", the reserve's main beach access (a long coastal reserve: pinned at a visitor point, not the centroid)
bio: Coastal reserve with eight kilometres of beach under sandstone cliffs, walking paths, barbecues and the Old Man Rock.
source_note: Coastal reserve of about 1500 hectares with 8 km of beach below sandstone cliffs, walking paths, barbecue areas and the Old Man Rock sacred site, 20 minutes from the city.
